name: brain-dash
description: Context and plan limits with a burn-rate projection, plus a deadline radar from a plain file or your own command, beside the code and above the prompt

radar_file.title: Deadlines file
radar_file.description: Relative to the project root. One deadline per line (2026-10-15 Text, ! at the end = critical), or JSON.

radar_command.title: Radar command
radar_command.description: Optional; when set, replaces the file. Runs at the project root, without a shell, and prints lines or JSON.

radar_days.title: Days ahead
radar_days.description: How many days ahead the radar shows (1 to 90).
